description: The plot illustrates the training loss over steps for several model variants fine-tuned on a 20M-sized molecular dataset, comparing architectures (ChemBART, ChemBERTa, ChemLLaMA) and model scales (Small, Medium). The x-axis, labeled “Step,” spans from 0K to 440K, with major ticks at 0K, 20K, 40K, 60K, 80K, and then zoomed-in ticks at 420K, 430K, and 440K, indicating a logarithmic or non-uniform scale in the later region. The y-axis, labeled “Train Loss,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.85, with major gridlines at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.75, and 0.85. Six distinct lines are plotted: ChemBART Small 20M (red, solid) starts near 0.85 and drops sharply to ~0.1 by 80K, then stabilizes near 0.05 by 440K; ChemBART Medium 20M (blue, solid) follows a similar trajectory, starting slightly lower and ending slightly higher than Small; ChemBERTa Medium 20M (orange, solid) begins near 0.8 and declines to ~0.08 by 440K; ChemLLaMA Small 20M (purple, solid) starts near 0.75 and converges to ~0.06; ChemLLaMA Medium 20M (brown, solid) begins near 0.7 and ends near 0.05. All models exhibit rapid initial loss reduction followed by slower convergence, with ChemLLaMA variants generally achieving lower final loss than ChemBART and ChemBERTa at similar steps. A gray bar in the legend obscures one entry, likely indicating a missing or redacted model variant.
